response.sql: WITH t AS (SELECT telescref, AVG(modindex) AS avg_mod FROM signals GROUP BY telescref HAVING AVG(modindex) IS NOT NULL), g AS (SELECT AVG(avg_mod) AS overall FROM t) SELECT t.telescref, t.avg_mod AS avg_modindex, t.avg_mod - g.overall AS excess_over_overall, t.avg_mod / g.overall AS ratio_to_overall FROM t CROSS JOIN g WHERE t.avg_mod > g.overall ORDER BY ratio_to_overall DESC LIMIT 10
